clue.text: Leader of such a quiet band

indicators.note: the leader of a word is the letter at its head, so only the opening letter is kept

parts.note: the first letter of such
taken as written
sh is the call for quiet

explanation.surface: Someone describes the bandleader of a particularly quiet group of musicians.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Band' looks like a group of musicians, but it is the definition: a strip of cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: A sash is a long strip of cloth worn around the waist or over the shoulder, a kind of band.

clue.text: Plant fake diamond

parts.note: a sham is a fake
rock is slang for a diamond

explanation.surface: Someone plants a fake diamond, as in framing a suspect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' reads as a verb for hiding false evidence, but it is the noun, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The shamrock is a small clover-like plant, the national emblem of Ireland.

clue.text: Keen group brought round instruments

indicators.note: something brought round other things wraps them, so this word goes outside

parts.note: a set is a group
harps are musical instruments

explanation.surface: An eager band gathers round its instruments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Keen' could be the group's mood, but it is the definition; sharp-set is an old word for hungry or eager.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharp-set means very hungry, and by extension eager or keen for something.

clue.text: Garland — girl on set

parts.note: Daisy is a girl's name
a chain is a connected set or series

explanation.surface: A garland worn by a girl on a film set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' just places the second piece after the first.
explanation.definitionFit: A daisy chain is a string of daisies threaded together, worn as a garland or wreath.

clue.text: Runs after a girl in park

indicators.note: after says the word for runs follows the little word a in the line

parts.note: taken as written
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
Ena is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Someone chases a girl through a public park.
explanation.walkthrough: Runs (R) comes after A, then the girl ENA follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Park in sporting use is a ground or stadium, as is an arena, an enclosed area for sport or spectacle.

clue.text: Good in bread? Yes, processed cheese

indicators.note: processed food is broken down and remade, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for good
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Asked whether something good is in the bread, someone answers yes: processed cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Processed cheese' reads as one phrase, but processed is the anagram signal and cheese alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Sage Derby is an English cheese marbled green with sage leaves.

clue.text: A scolding from one's wife in retirement?

definitions.text: A scolding from one's wife in retirement?

parts.words: A scolding from one's wife in retirement?
parts.note: surface reading: a man being nagged by his wife once he has stopped working
setter's reading: retirement means going to bed, where an old four-poster had curtains drawn round it

explanation.walkthrough: Retirement here is retiring for the night, not leaving work; the phrase is an old one for a wife's telling-off delivered in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A curtain lecture is a reproof given by a wife to her husband in bed, behind the bed curtains.

clue.text: High explosive found in dam at Oldham

indicators.note: found in says the letters sit inside the words that follow, ready to be read straight off

parts.note: the letters run across dam, at and the start of Oldham

explanation.surface: Explosives discovered in a reservoir dam in the Lancashire town of Oldham.
explanation.definitionFit: Amatol is a high explosive made from TNT and ammonium nitrate.

clue.text: Goad a pointer

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to provoke or irritate
second meaning: the indicator on a dial or compass

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests goading a dog, but the two words are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a verb meaning provoke and a noun for the slender indicator on a gauge.

clue.text: West Indian, inside Union Station, relaxed with Catch-22?

indicators.note: inside says one piece is placed within the letters of the other
something relaxed has loosened its order, so the letters are set free to rearrange

parts.note: taken as written
WI is the abbreviation for West Indian or West Indies

explanation.surface: A West Indian traveller relaxes inside a railway station with a copy of Heller's novel Catch-22.
explanation.walkthrough: WI goes into UNION STATION, then all fourteen letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A Catch-22 is a dilemma where every option fails, which is exactly a no-win situation.

clue.text: Seaman's single shellfish

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor
single means alone

explanation.surface: A sailor eats a single shellfish.
explanation.definitionFit: The abalone is an edible sea snail, a shellfish with an ear-shaped shell.

clue.text: Language used by last in queue is apt

parts.note: German is a language

indicators.note: the last in a word is its final letter, the only one kept

parts.note: the final letter of queue

explanation.surface: A remark that the language spoken by the last person in a queue is fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: Germane means relevant or pertinent, so an apt remark is germane.

clue.text: Admonish travelling salesman, chap stopping to deliver

parts.note: a rep, a representative, is a travelling salesman

indicators.note: a stopping plugs a gap, so this piece is put into the middle of the next word

parts.note: rid means free or deliver, as in deliver us from evil
a chap is a man

explanation.surface: Telling off a travelling salesman who stops to make a delivery.
explanation.walkthrough: REP, then MAN plugs RID: REP + RI(MAN)D.
explanation.definitionFit: A reprimand is a formal rebuke; as a verb it means to admonish.

clue.text: Key from a ring

parts.note: taken as written
to toll a bell is to ring it

explanation.surface: Taking a key off a key ring.
explanation.walkthrough: Key here is a low island or reef, as in the Florida Keys, not a thing for a lock.
explanation.definitionFit: A key or cay is a low coral island, and an atoll is a ring-shaped coral island.

clue.text: Close and hot in Greece and Spain? Possibly

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed among the letters of the words that follow
possibly signals one of several possible arrangements of the letters

parts.note: the two country names taken as written
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Talk of a close, hot summer climate in Greece and Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Close and hot' reads as muggy weather, but close is the definition, meaning stingy.
explanation.definitionFit: Close means mean with money, and cheeseparing describes miserly economy over tiny amounts.

clue.text: Picture of boy in doorway

indicators.note: in places one word inside the letters of the other

parts.note: a portal is a doorway
Ray is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A photograph of a boy standing in a doorway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Picture' could be the noun or a verb; here it is a noun, a depiction.
explanation.definitionFit: A portrayal is a depiction or representation, which is what a picture is.

clue.text: British law one breaks supplying bottled beer

indicators.note: something that breaks falls apart, so these letters are scattered and reassembled

parts.note: Br is an abbreviation for British
the letters of law and one rearranged

explanation.surface: A British rule-breaker supplies bottled beer illegally.
explanation.definitionFit: Brown ale is a dark, sweetish English beer usually sold in bottles.

clue.text: Create havoc in stage show — he will, shortly

indicators.note: said shortly means in contracted form, so the phrase loses letters as in speech

parts.note: a play is a stage show
he'll is the contraction of he will, written without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: An actor warns he will cause chaos during the stage show.
explanation.definitionFit: To play hell is an idiom meaning to cause chaos or make an angry fuss.

clue.text: Morsel, pretty fancy for Mother Carey's chicken

indicators.note: fancy as a verb means imagine, so the letters are reimagined in another order

parts.note: the two words taken as written

explanation.surface: A pretty, fancy titbit is offered to someone's chicken.
explanation.walkthrough: Mother Carey's chicken is an old sailors' name for the bird, not a farmyard hen.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailors called the storm petrel, a small seabird, Mother Carey's chicken.

clue.text: Himalayan mountain guide's turn of phrase?

indicators.note: a turn moves something round, so the letters that follow are turned about

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A Himalayan guide has a particular way with words.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn of phrase' is a stock expression; split it, and turn of becomes the instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherpas are a Himalayan people famed as guides and porters on mountain expeditions.

clue.text: Call for English translation of Latin

indicators.note: a translation reworks words into a new form, so these letters are reworked too

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for English
the letters of Latin rearranged

explanation.surface: A request for an English rendering of a Latin text.
explanation.definitionFit: To entail is to involve or necessitate, so a task that calls for something entails it.

clue.text: Dye girl applied to front of head, then back

indicators.note: the front of a word is its opening letter, so only that is kept

parts.note: the opening letter of head

indicators.note: back says the girl's name is turned to run the other way

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl applies dye to the front of her head, then to the back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Then back' reads as dyeing the back of the head, but it tells you to turn the girl's name round.
explanation.definitionFit: Henna is a reddish-brown dye made from the leaves of a shrub, used on hair and skin.

clue.text: Fair treatment abroad, without delay

parts.note: right is what is fair and just
to be abroad is to be away from home

explanation.surface: Someone demands fair treatment while overseas, immediately.
explanation.definitionFit: Right away is an idiom meaning immediately, at once.

clue.text: See head of glamour girl in mirror

indicators.note: the head of a word is its opening letter, the only one kept

parts.note: the opening letter of glamour
a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: A glamour model checks her reflection in a mirror.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass, short for looking glass, is a mirror.

clue.text: Willingly study? One's extremely lazy

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: extremely here means at the extremes, so only the two end letters are kept

parts.note: the first and last letters of lazy

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to study willingly, and is told they are extremely lazy.
explanation.definitionFit: Readily means without hesitation or reluctance, that is, willingly.

clue.text: Where one may see fighter pilots in sky, low

definitions.text: Where one may see fighter pilots

parts.note: the air is the sky
base means low, as in base metals or base motives

explanation.surface: Fighter pilots seen flying low in the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: An air base is a military airfield, the home station of fighter squadrons and their pilots.

clue.text: After much delay in a stall, got racing (all bar one)

indicators.note: racing letters dash about and finish in a new order
all bar one means every letter except the one standing for the number one is used

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A horse, long delayed in its stall, finally got racing.
explanation.walkthrough: From the letters of in a stall got, drop the I (one), then rearrange the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: At long last means finally, after a long wait, which is after much delay.

clue.text: Aquatic mammal in close

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the sea creature with flippers

explanation.walkthrough: 'In close' suggests a mammal close by; in only joins the two meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a noun for a flippered marine mammal and a verb meaning shut tight.
